# Audio

Spatial sound sources and the listener.

## `audio` { #audio }

Plays a sound clip from this entity: music, ambience, sound effects. Spatial by default (louder when near, panned left/right). Plays only while the game runs. Generate clips with the audio_generate tool, then set `clip`. One-shots are easier from Wander: play_sound("audio/hit.wav").

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | Audio file in the project (wav, mp3 or flac), e.g. audio/wind_loop.wav |  |
| `volume` | number | Linear gain (1 = unchanged) | 0 .. 4 |
| `pitch` | number | Playback speed multiplier; also shifts pitch | 0.1 .. 4 |
| `loop` | boolean | Repeat the clip forever (ambience, music, engines) |  |
| `playOnStart` | boolean | Start automatically when the game starts |  |
| `spatial` | boolean | 3D sound: distance attenuation and panning; false = plain stereo (music, UI) |  |
| `minDistance` | number | Full volume within this distance (m) | 0.01 .. 10000 |
| `maxDistance` | number | Distance where attenuation stops (inverse/exponential) or reaches silence (linear) | 0.1 .. 100000 |
| `rolloff` | string | Distance falloff curve (inverse is physically natural; linear fades to silence at maxDistance) | `inverse` `linear` `exponential` `none` |
| `rolloffFactor` | number | Falloff steepness (1 = natural) | 0 .. 20 |
| `bus` | string | Mixer bus whose volume/mute applies (see the audio_mix tool) | `master` `music` `sfx` `ambience` `voice` `ui` |
| `doppler` | number | Doppler effect strength for moving emitters (0 = off, 1 = realistic) | 0 .. 5 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"audio": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.audio.clip          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `listener` { #listener }

The ears of the game. Optional: by default sound is heard from the active scene camera. Put this on another entity (the player character) to hear from there.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | Use this entity as the listener |  |
| `volume` | number | Overall gain heard by this listener | 0 .. 4 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"listener": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.listener.enabled          -- read or write any field
    ```
